CustomField.description: Address of the Organization-Wide Email Address that sends the emails to channel partners (access approved, registration rejected and so on). It must exist under Setup > Organization-Wide Addresses, be verified and be allowed for all profiles. Never a Gmail or other public mailbox: mail providers block such emails. Blank, unknown or not verified: the emails go out in the name of the user who triggered them.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Verified Organization-Wide Email Address that sends the emails to channel partners. Never a Gmail or other public mailbox. Blank: emails go out in the name of the user who triggered them.
CustomField.label: Email Sender Address
